about: SCION 35 trace, measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen = centroid of the rendered dog coverage (film px, static camera); facing = +1 when the rendered head layer sits > 6 px on the door side of the rendered torso, -1 on the far side, 0 when it is over the body (rear view mid-turn); posture from the rendered height vs the standing height; state = the score state switched at the onsets MEASURED here (signals listed in summary); strain per layer = [max anisotropy of the dot grid (s1/s2), min and max area ratio, folded cells]; x_score = the score x the dog was placed at.

onsets_measured.signal: dog centroid moves > 1 px away from the door (from its 0.75 s place)
rendered head centre rises > 3 px above its lowest (cowering) height
rendered head centre swings > 4 px away from the door, relative to the torso
rendered head centre swings > 4 px toward the door, relative to the torso (hips still down)
dog centroid moves > 1 px toward the door
top of the rendered dog drops > 5 px

look_in.signal: rendered head centre moves > 3 px (turning in through the door)
